items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Max Gordon, and the interviewee responds to the interviewer's statements about him ('Yes. He’s lying...'), indicating awareness but no direct personal interaction or relationship described by the interviewee.

ctx.x: Max Gordon I used to work for every so often, and he put me in there... Colomby got me in there.
